headline: Nickal Vs Pyfer
question: Nickal or Pyfer?
caption:
Bo Nickal and Joe Pyfer are finally set to settle it at UFC 335.
Nickal or Pyfer? 👇

The middleweight fight was revealed during the UFC 332 broadcast for Dec. 12 at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas. Brandon Moreno vs. Charles Johnson was also added, on a card headlined by Charles Oliveira vs. Diego Lopes for the BMF title. UFC news and fight announcement.

Who gets the finish?
